title: Ashbury Rewards Console Reference: Night Credits for Reward Night Rate Stays
content:
A completed Reward Night Rate stay credited to the membership posts its elite night credits as one stay nights transaction naming the stay. The posting is made on the member's Ashbury Rewards account.

## Conditions of the result

- Night credits are posted only to a membership whose status is active, and an award stay posts night credits at most once.
- Only night credits posted for an award stay beyond the total the award-stay rule gives it are reversed against its night-credit transaction.

## Capability

`post_award_stay_night_credits_8b07b6a3` posts the elite night credits of a completed Reward Night Rate stay to an Ashbury Rewards account. One call records one night-credit transaction of source `stay_nights` that names the award stay, dated today, and adds the credits to the elite night credits of the current calendar year shown on the membership. The member sees the credits in their account activity and in their elite night total straight away.

## Invocation

The tool is an agent-side tool. The agent unlocks it with `unlock_agent_discoverable_tool`, giving the name `post_award_stay_night_credits_8b07b6a3`, and then calls it with `call_agent_discoverable_tool`.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `loyalty_member_id` | Reference number of the Ashbury Rewards membership credited, as returned by the membership lookup for the verified member | Identifier |
| `reservation_id` | Reference number of the completed Reward Night Rate reservation the credits are for, as returned by the reservation lookup | Identifier |
| `earning_source` | Business source recorded on the transaction | Closed set of one value: `stay_nights` — night credits earned by nights stayed on a completed stay |
| `nights` | Elite night credits posted for the stay | Whole number of nights, always positive; integer, no decimals, no unit text |

## Return

A dictionary string with `transaction_id` (reference number of the night-credit transaction created), `loyalty_member_id` (membership credited), `reservation_id` (award stay named), `earning_source` (source recorded), `nights` (integer credits posted), `posted_date` (posting date, YYYY-MM-DD) and `elite_night_credits` (the membership's elite night total once the credits are added). A returned `transaction_id` means the credits are posted.

## Input and return (hypothetical values)

An account showing 31 elite night credits receives a posting with `nights` of 6: the return shows `nights` 6, today's `posted_date` and `elite_night_credits` 37.
